RollMode.Name: Default Roll Mode
RollMode.Hint: Choose whether rolls default to physical table dice or digital rolls.

CleanupMode.Name: Card Resolution Cleanup
CleanupMode.Hint: Automatically remove or minimize the pending input card once the roll resolves.

AllowGmOverride.Hint: Allow the GM to input physical dice results on behalf of players.

EntryMethod.Hint: Choose whether physical dice numbers are entered via a popup dialog or directly in the chat log (e.g. for GMs who prefer minimal screen clutter).
